```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<section><h3>Section Heading</h3><p>Section content.</p></section>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
